$comment: Spec 016 T02 - the pinned infrastructure toolchain.
scripts/azure/Test-ProductionPlan.ps1 compiles and lints the Bicep templates
only with this exact Bicep CLI version, restored from its official NuGet
package and verified against the recorded SHA-512 before it is executed. A
locally installed or floating Bicep version is never used. Changing the version
requires re-recording every hash below from the official package.
